The Ann–Ben block is consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus after Ben at least three slots from Ann. The only placement that also keeps Dev at least three from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus (and Dev before Gus) is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7, which forces Gus into 9 and Hana into 8.

The remaining distance constraints then force the first five slots: Dev in 1 (only slot far enough from both Cara and Ann), Finn in 2 (at least three from both Ben and Elif), Ivo in 3 (at least three from Ben, and before Gus), Cara in 4, Elif in 5. Every constraint holds, and every other Ann–Ben position contradicts at least one distance or order constraint.
